attchmntText: Ashok Leyland Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 14, 2026, declared Interim Dividend of Re. 1 per equity share.
voiceSummary: Ashok Leyland Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company declared an interim dividend of Rs. 1 per equity share for the financial year ending 2026-27. Payment is scheduled on or before December 13, 2026. The record date for determining eligible members is November 20, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the six months ended September 30, 2026, stood at Rs. 22,998.63 crores, with a profit after tax of Rs. 1,478.12 crores. Consolidated revenue from operations for the same period was Rs. 30,099.46 crores, with a profit after tax of Rs. 891.45 crores. The board meeting concluded at 6.00 P.M. IST on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Ashok Leyland Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  Mr. Venkatesan Venkataraman as Additional Director in the category of Non-Executive Non-Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ashok Leyland Limited appointed Mr. Venkatesan Venkataraman, DIN 09635261, as Additional Director in the capacity of Non-Executive Non-Independent Director, liable to retire by rotation, with effect from November 14, 2026. This appointment was approved by the Board of Directors following the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. The appointment is subject to shareholder approval within the timelines prescribed under the SEBI Listing Regulations. Mr. Venkatesan is a British national with over 45 years of experience in the commercial vehicle sector. He currently serves as President of Hinduja Automotive Limited. He is not related to any Directors of the Company. He is not debarred from holding the office of director. The Board meeting commenced at 2.45 P.M. IST and concluded at 6.00 P.M. IST.

attchmntText: Ashok Leyland Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Earnings Call
voiceSummary: Ashok Leyland Limited has intimated the schedule for an earnings conference call on Monday, November 16, 2026, at 11.00 A.M. IST. The event will feature the company's Q2FY27 performance and business updates. Management participants include Mr. Shenu Agarwal, Managing Director and CEO, and Mr. K M Balaji, Whole-Time Director and CFO. The call is facilitated by Kotak Institutional Equities. Participants can join via a universal dial-in number or a web link for Diamond pass registration. The schedule is subject to change. This notice is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
